scope: bounded native technical masks unit; no watched/heard/creative claim

decoded_picture.zero_mse: record exact_identity true and psnr_db null; do not emit Infinity
decoded_picture.roi_definition: generate and hash exact frame-local rectangles before export from the selected fixture and independent reference

regions.definition: source-bearing clipped picture-window pixels with raw mask coverage65536

source-bearing clipped picture-window pixels whose final effective weight is zero; compare the final composed reference including other layers
clipped destination rectangle minus fitted source-bearing picture window

decoded_picture.nonempty_regions: require coordinates, RGB sample count, MSE and pass at34dB or exact identity separately
decoded_picture.empty_regions: record empty with sample_count0 and no metric or pass claim
decoded_picture.lossy_scope: pure byte equality is edge-arithmetic authority; H.264 ROI measurements are separate

audio.clock: integer epoch/ticks/timescale; reject booleans/missing epoch; positive continuous chunks and EOF
audio.captures: retain each fresh capture; compare each to its actual WAV interval; do not require identical f32 bytes
